internship.description: Contributed to the web-based learning platform of Best Brains, a US-based education company headquartered in Arlington Heights, Illinois, that offers Math, English, Abacus and Coding programs for children aged 3 to 14 through learning centres and online classes. Assisted with front-end development and supported improvements to the online tools used in tutoring and running classes.
internship.learned: This was my first time inside a live ed-tech platform: seeing how it is designed, built and maintained, and working within an organisational tech team. Code I wrote wasn’t a practice exercise anymore. Tutors and students would use it in their classes, and that changed how I thought about everything from testing to small details in the interface.

cs50.title: Harvard CS50 (edX)
cs50.description: Completed Harvard's CS50 online course end-to-end, working through problem sets in C, Python, SQL and JavaScript and building hands-on projects involving algorithms, data structures and web development.
cs50.changed: CS50 taught me structured problem-solving: break a big problem into small pieces, solve one, test it, move on. That way of working shaped how I approach complex problems, including later projects like Kisan AI.

headBoy.title: Head Boy
highlights: Led the school in all events, activities and tours
Represented Shamrock International School at external activities
Coordinated with students and staff to manage school events
Guided fellow students with responsibility and empathy
headBoy.reflection: Leadership taught me to lead with responsibility, confidence and empathy.

taught.v: You choose in a second, then live with it.
Five people, one plan, constant communication.
Staying clear-headed when the clock is running.
Reading the other side and adapting the plan.
Losing a game, learning from it, coming back.

policyIntro: AI doesn’t only raise technical questions. It raises political, economic and ethical ones. Across four committees at VIVA MUN, IIMUN and Harvard MUN India, I debated AI and employment, AI-based weapons and space debris, arguing about technology as a diplomat, not a developer.
